create.name: Rae Calnan
create.bio:
Rae Calnan is a spiritual guide and Angelic Reiki Master Teacher based in Dartford, Kent, who has worked with Angelic Reiki for more than seventeen years. She grew up visiting spiritualist churches with her parents among relatives who read tarot, and later explored runes and a Pagan path. A trek to Machu Picchu in 2002 led her to leave office work for a life of spiritual service. She qualified to teach Angelic Reiki in 2014 and went on to train in hypnotherapy, which opened the way to past life regression and future life progression.

From her therapy room in Dartford and over Zoom she gives Angelic Reiki sessions, regression and progression journeys and angel card readings, and she teaches small in-person Angelic Reiki workshops from the first levels up to Master Teacher. Once a month she hosts An Afternoon With The Angels, an informal gathering with conversation, card readings and a guided meditation, and she runs the Angel Wings membership for people who want regular practice and company. Her guided meditations, many of them tied to the solstices, equinoxes and Celtic festivals, are on Insight Timer and in a downloadable collection, and she presents the Angels & Destiny podcast on YouTube.

courses.title: Angelic Reiki Session
courses.description: A one-hour Angelic Reiki session, given online or in person in Dartford, in which you rest fully clothed while Rae acts as a channel for the energy. A series of three sessions is also offered for £222 GBP.

courses.title: Angelic Reiki Workshops & Training
courses.description: Four in-person workshops in Dartford, from Levels 1 and 2 through Levels 3 and 4 and Practitioner to Master Teacher, taught in small groups with attunements and hands-on practice. Students can stop at any level, and booking several levels together is discounted.

courses.title: Past Life Regression
courses.description: A guided session of up to two hours in which you are led into a relaxed, dreamlike state to explore a past life and what it may mean for you now. Held in Dartford or on Zoom, with a recording sent afterwards; a block of three costs £360 GBP.

courses.title: Future Life Progression
courses.description: A guided journey forward in time to look at possible paths ahead, such as where your life might be in five or ten years, so you return to the present with a clearer sense of direction. In person in Dartford or online, recorded for you to keep.

courses.title: Divine Presence Session
courses.description: A session of about two hours in which Rae guides you in deep relaxation to Correl, an inner retreat she describes as a place of unconditional love, where past or future lives may also come up. A recording of the journey is included.

courses.title: Angel Card Reading
courses.description: A 30-minute reading by Zoom or in Dartford that uses angel cards to look at what is happening now rather than to predict events. A six-month card package is also available for £170 GBP.

courses.title: SoulPath Discovery Programme
courses.description: A one-to-one programme of live sessions that combines Angelic Reiki, past life and future life journeys and card readings, with time between meetings to reflect. Sessions are recorded and Rae stays in touch for support along the way.

courses.title: Angel Wings Membership
courses.description: An online community with a monthly guided meditation, a monthly live question-and-answer call, practical workshops on oracle cards and intuition, and a library of recordings. Members also join the monthly Afternoon With The Angels; a yearly plan is £240 GBP.

courses.title: Sacred Healing Meditation Collection
courses.description: Four guided meditations written and voiced by Rae for quiet moments of rest and reconnection. Downloadable and ad-free, with lifetime access.

courses.title: An Afternoon With The Angels
courses.description: A monthly Sunday gathering in Dartford, with tea and biscuits, conversation about angels, card readings and a guided meditation; people further away can join online. Book by contacting Rae.

free_resources.title: Rae Calnan on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations and visualisations from Rae, many marking the solstices, equinoxes and Celtic festivals with an archangel. Free to listen to on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Free 5-Day Angel Connection Journey
free_resources.description: A free step-by-step guide sent by email over five days, with simple practices for connecting with your angels and guides. Sign-up with a name and email address is needed.
